answer: Force every identity to grow a vine of chained micro-tasks: each step's puzzle is seeded by the previous step's answer, so the work cannot be split, shared, or copied across fakes. Rewards stay locked until the chain is complete, and one wrong step prunes the branch. A thousand fakes must each climb its own vine, one slow step at a time, while a single honest agent tends one small garden plot. There is no comet shortcut: the cost to the farmer is time itself, and time cannot be bought in bulk.
